scope: Part II Stage 01 normal — three object-boss comparisons using actual Part I references
generation_schedule: Stage01 and Stage05 ran as independent parallel jobs; within each stage the three concepts were generated sequentially. Maximum two image-generation calls at once.

images.concept_ko: 모래시계 자체가 본체인 삼각 지지형 관측 오브젝트. 세 받침과 상단 관측팔, 두 보호 호가 기능을 드러낸다.

part1_references.role: Fixed-surface sculptural mass and cel materials; no exact body/face copy.
Living-object construction, hollow joints and large connected plates; no face/hair/layout copy.
Architectural palette/floor readability and restrained setting style only.

images.visual_qa: Final refined image visually inspected: scanner hinge, two side shields and all three feet have clear canvas margins. Body remains an intact hourglass with sand inside only. No human face, skin, hair or costume; one supported observation arm and three leg supports retained.
images.refinement_reason: Camera pulled back about 7 percent to create clear margin above the scanner hinge and around the feet; original design preserved.

images.concept_ko: 기울어진 큰 석재 관에 인체의 손 흔적만 잠식되어 있다. 한 손은 윗마개를 감싸고 다른 손은 바닥을 짚어 짧은 두 받침과 하중을 나눈다.

images.visual_qa: Visually inspected: thick asymmetrical casket body dominates, with two carved hand remnants, two pedestal feet and a geometric survey cap. No actual human head/skin/face. Full sealed hourglass and internal sand visible; joints and hand roots connected.

images.concept_ko: 눈·표정 없는 기하학 관측 캡과 고정된 외피가 몸인 인형 석상. 짧은 발과 낮게 모인 두 돌손 사이에 모래시계를 품는다.

images.visual_qa: Final refined image visually inspected: one rigid ivory support post visibly joins sealed head cap and shoulder beam, with gold collar/bolts at the interfaces. No anatomical neck, face, eyes, hair or skin. Intact hourglass, carved hands, two feet, rigid side panels and clean cel style preserved. Full silhouette in frame.
images.refinement_reason: Ambiguous dark cap-to-shoulder gap replaced with a short thick ivory support post and light-gold bolted collar.

common_visual_qa: All three selected PNGs viewed. Actual Part I images were used in every initial generation. No previous Part II character image was used as an initial generation reference. No actual human portrait, eyes/pupils, fashion hair, realistic skin or costume-led character. Broad ivory/gold/navy sculptural masses, fixed surfaces, lavender cel shadows and coherent large support interfaces retained. No 3D mesh, UV, rigging or animation validation performed.
workspace_changes: Only this stage folder. Existing art, shared direction notes and other stage options preserved.
